Layered swells under a glowing horizon, or thin lines like a sound wave, drawn as a dither.

Preview
Code
Controls
Replay
Expand
CONTROLS
Reset
COLOUR
VARIANT
ocean
lines
AMPLITUDE
1
ANIMATE
Installation
npm
yarn
pnpm
bun
pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add https://dithercn.dev/r/waves.json
Copy
Manual installation
Usage
Copy
import { Waves } from "@/components/dithercn/waves";
 
export function Footer() {
  return (
    <footer className="relative isolate min-h-[320px]">
      <Waves className="absolute inset-0 -z-10" />
    </footer>
  );
}

Rows of swells roll towards you below the horizon. Distant rows are small and bright, near ones large and dark, and every crest has a one-cell highlight.

Examples
Dusk

A lower horizon, eight layers and a warm palette give a sea at sunset. A smaller amplitude calms the water.

Preview
Code
Replay
Expand
Sound wave

variant="lines" draws thin lines that swell in the middle and taper at both ends. It suits audio players, voice input and anything that listens.

Preview
Code
Replay
Expand
Props
Prop	Type	Default
variant

Swells under a horizon, or thin lines like a sound wave.

	"ocean" | "lines"	"ocean"
horizon

Ocean only. Height of the horizon, from 0 (bottom) to 1 (top).

	number	0.62
layers

How many waves, from 2 to 8.

	number	6
amplitude

Height of the waves. 1 is calm, 2 is rough.

	number	1
palette

Colours from paper to ink: palette names such as "blue", CSS variable names, or any CSS colour.

	[DitherColor, DitherColor, ...DitherColor[]]	Paper, then tints of --dither-ink
matrix

The threshold pattern. See Dither engine.

	"bayer2" | "bayer4" | "bayer8" | "blue-noise"	"bayer4"
cell

Size of one dither cell in CSS pixels.

	number	--dither-cell
speed

How fast it moves.

	number	1
animate

false stops the motion: a still frame if it starts off, the current frame if it was moving.

	boolean	true
className

Size and position. The background fills this box.

	string	–
Notes
It is decorative and hidden from assistive technology. Put real text on top of it, not inside it.
With reduced motion turned on, it draws one still frame and stops.
It pauses when scrolled out of view or when the tab is hidden, and releases its WebGL context when far offscreen. Without WebGL it shows a CSS approximation in the same colours.
It costs one small draw per frame at 30 fps, at one pixel per dither cell. See Performance.
